scenicChapters.title: Sri Lanka Hill Country Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 34 km this is Sri Lanka Hill Country Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

story: A one-way ride of 338 km, Matale to Matale - roughly 5 h 50 in the saddle. The stops in between: Sacred City of Kandy, Peak Wilderness Protected Area, Sinharaja Forest Reserve and back through Peak Wilderness Protected Area. The highest point is about 1,100 m. Long stretches are under trees.
